name: Beginner
style: New York-style salsa (NY On2 / Eddie Torres-style mambo)

techniques.name: Basic Step
techniques.description: 1-2-3, 5-6-7. Back on left foot as leader. Foundation of everything.

techniques.name: Around the World
techniques.description: A directional variation of the On2 basic where you keep the same 1-2-3, 5-6-7 timing while rotating through clock-face positions instead of staying on one line.

techniques.name: Half Step
techniques.description: A shortened Around the World transition where you take only half of the full directional change before anchoring and redirecting into the next phrase.

notes_from_class.basic_step: Back on left foot. Count: 1-2-3, 5-6-7. Left, left, forward as leader.
notes_from_class.inside_turn: On the basic (1-2-3, 5-6-7), lift her hand up on the 1 to signal the turn. She turns on 1-2. Leader's right turn: go 1-2-3 then quick turn, 5-6-7.
